ORv3 racks

Open-rack configurations with liquid distribution, power and cable management. IT compatibility agreed per project.

An ORv3 rack for liquid-cooled IT is a distribution system before it is a piece of furniture. The vertical manifold, the quick-disconnect positions, the busbar and the cable pathways all have to be agreed against the servers the owner is actually buying, and against the CDU that will feed them.

We configure ORv3 racks around the project's IT list: rack power, manifold sizing and QD standard, blind-mate or hose connection, leak detection routing and the service clearances the operator will need in year three. Racks are built to our specification by manufacturing partners we qualify, and each one leaves the factory with a pressure-test record and a quick-disconnect register at zero mate cycles.

Where a project mixes rack integrators, we hold the interface: which party proves the rack manifold, which proves the row manifold, and what the record for the joint between them looks like.

What we ask the project to decide early
  • IT list and rack power confirmed before manifold sizing
  • QD standard and blind-mate or hose connection decided
  • Leak detection and isolation per rack or per row, stated
  • Service clearances agreed with the operator
